create_default_checkpointer: create a DefaultCheckpointer that stores checkpoints to recordIO files in a specified path
create_tempdir_checkpointer: create a TempDirCheckpointer that stores and loads checkpoints from a temporary directory
build_checkpointer_with_fallback: build a DefaultCheckpointer with a fallback checkpoint path to initialize from another experiment
build_checkpointer_with_group: build a DefaultCheckpointer with an MDB group to set the checkpoint directory group
test_internal_checkpointer: test the internal_checkpointer method that returns a pybind.Checkpointer for the C++ layer
